title: Otto Stool
tagline: Solid walnut, made from our offcuts

content.text: Otto started as a way to use the offcuts from our larger pieces. The seat is turned from a single block, and the legs are wedged right through it for a joint that only gets tighter.
Use it as a stool, a side table or a plant stand. Most people end up with two.

care: Wipe with a soft, damp cloth and dry straight away. Re-oil once or twice a year with the care kit included.
